questions.stem: Why is it more energy-efficient for humans to eat plants rather than meat?

options.text: Less energy is lost because we are eating at a lower trophic level
Plants contain more protein than meat
Animals do not contain any energy

questions.explanation: Eating plants means consuming at a lower trophic level, so less energy has been lost through the food chain. An animal has already used much of the plant energy for its own life processes before we eat it.
